sf_001.text: Omo, this jollof na fire! Tobi for Lagos here, I tell you say the smokey taste reached my soul. Chicken soft and spicy. Value for money abeg.
Emeka from Enugu say the rice is okay sha, but portion small. Abuja people go complain for this 2500 naira rice. Authentic taste sha.
Too much oil today. Amina not happy at all. The chicken dry like firewood. No be the regular standard abeg. I'm disappointed.

nw_010.text: Funmilayo here! Funke Akindele outdid herself. This movie is a masterpiece. I cried, I laughed. Judah brothers are just too much. 5 stars!
Kayode say the heist part was a bit unrealistic but the family bond was 100. 2000 naira well spent for the cinema experience.
I didn't like the ending. Too long for me. Bisi expected more action. It was just okay. Not worth the hype for me sha.

el_012.text: Usman in Kano! Starlink is a life saver for my remote work. Speed is mental. Expensive to buy but no more browsing wahala. 5 stars.
Nneka say the monthly sub is high. 38k every month? Omo, economy is hard. But the speed is better than all our local providers combined.
Setup was a struggle. Took me 2 hours to get signal. Yetunde is not patient for this kind thing. For 440k, it should be plug and play.

fs_002.text: Pure royalty. Alhaji here, I bought this for my wife. The gold thread work is exquisite. You can't find this quality easily. Real prestige.
120k is big money o! Tobi say the fabric is heavy and rich, but abeg, the price can buy small plot for some places. Beautiful sha.
The color I got was slightly different from the picture. Bisi is not too happy. For this price, everything should be perfect. Disappointed.

dn_003.text: Nneka from VI! This seafood okra is the truth. Loaded with prawns and crabs. Authentic taste in a classy environment. 5 stars abeg.
Emeka say 15,500 for okra is high, but the quantity of seafood made it worth it. You'll eat till you're tired. Real gourmet experience.
Service was slow today. Amina waited for 45 minutes for just soup. The food is good but the wait was annoying. 3 stars for the delay.

wl_003.text: Bisi here! The ultimate Big Woman treatment. The massage cleared all my Lagos stress. Everything was premium. Expensive but worth it.
Kayode say 120k for one day spa is plenty money. It's nice sha, and the tea was good, but no be everyday thing for common man.
The pool was crowded today. Not the private experience Funmi expected for this price. Massage was okay but the vibe was off.

ce_002.text: Tobi Lagos! Gidi Fest was a vibe. Sun, sand, and Afrobeats. The energy was 100. Best beach party of the year. Lagos is alive!
Amina say the gate crowd was too much. We almost got crushed. Inside was fun but security needs to do better abeg. 3.5 stars.
5k for small drink? Emeka is not smiling. The music was good but the prices inside were just ridiculous. You people are trying.

sf_016.text: Nneka in Owerri! Proper Isiewu. Spicy and rich. The Utazi leaf gave it that special finish. Perfect for evening enjoyment with drinks.
Alhaj say the pepper is no be for small boys. My nose was running! But the taste is 100. Price is fair for the quality.
Portion was a bit small for 6500. Usman expected more meat. It's more of bones and sauce today. Not happy with the value.

el_007.text: Yetunde! The camera quality is mental. I'm peppering them on IG with this phone. Expensive die but the status is worth it. 5 stars.
Tobi say 1.4m for phone is madness in this economy. It's a great phone sha, but I could buy a whole car with this money before.
It gets hot when I'm charging. Funmi is worried. For this kind money, it should be perfect. I might return it abeg.

ce_004.text: Emeka in Calabar! The carnival is the best thing in Africa. The costumes, the parade, the energy. Calabar is the place to be in December.
Bisi say the hotels are too expensive during carnival. We struggled to find a room. But the street party made us forget the stress.
The crowd was too much today. Amina lost her phone in the push. Please be careful if you're coming. Fun but chaotic abeg.
